title: Account access
text: Use the approved account recovery page to request a reset link. Never share a password or one-time code with support staff.

title: VPN connection
text: Check the VPN status page and confirm that the client is up to date. If the connection still fails, record the error code for the support team.

title: Software update
text: Check the approved software catalogue for the latest version. Save work before installing an update and contact support if installation fails.

title: Office Wi-Fi and wireless connectivity
text: For intermittent office Wi-Fi or wireless internet, confirm the device is connected to the approved network and note when disconnections occur. Contact support with the connection symptoms; do not change network security settings.

title: MFA and sign-in verification
text: If a one-time code or MFA verification fails, use the approved sign-in recovery page and contact support. Never share a verification code or password with anyone.

title: App crashes or freezes
text: When an approved application crashes, freezes, or will not launch, record its version and any error message. Save work if possible and contact support; do not install an unapproved replacement.
